description: Defines data structures, constants, macros, and API function prototypes for Redis Cluster implementation, including node management, message protocol, and cluster state handling.

classes.name: clusterNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Redis Cluster, including its state, slots, IP, ports, and links to other nodes.

classes.name: clusterLink
classes.description: Encapsulates connection details to communicate with a remote cluster node.

classes.name: clusterState
classes.description: Maintains overall cluster status, nodes, slots, and election info.

classes.name: clusterMsg
classes.description: Defines the message protocol used for gossip, node communication, and cluster management.

methods.name: clusterInit
methods.description: Initializes the Redis Cluster subsystem.

methods.name: clusterCron
methods.description: Performs periodic cluster maintenance tasks.

methods.name: clusterBeforeSleep
methods.description: Prepares cluster state before server sleep or shutdown.

methods.name: getNodeByQuery
methods.description: Finds a cluster node based on client query context.

methods.name: verifyClusterNodeId
methods.description: Verifies if a node ID is valid.

methods.name: clusterLookupNode
methods.description: Looks up a node by name.

methods.name: clusterRedirectBlockedClientIfNeeded
methods.description: Redirects client if cluster conditions require it.

methods.name: clusterRedirectClient
methods.description: Redirects a client to another node.

methods.name: migrateCloseTimedoutSockets
methods.description: Closes sockets that have timed out during migration.

methods.name: verifyClusterConfigWithData
methods.description: Checks cluster configuration consistency with data.

methods.name: getClusterConnectionsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active cluster connections.

methods.name: clusterSendModuleMessageToTarget
methods.description: Sends a module message to a target node.

methods.name: clusterPropagatePublish
methods.description: Propagates a publish message across the cluster.

methods.name: keyHashSlot
methods.description: Computes hash slot for a given key.

methods.name: slotToKeyAddEntry
methods.description: Adds a key entry to a slot.

methods.name: slotToKeyDelEntry
methods.description: Deletes a key entry from a slot.

methods.name: slotToKeyReplaceEntry
methods.description: Replaces a key entry in a slot.

methods.name: slotToKeyInit
methods.description: Initializes slot to key mappings.

methods.name: slotToKeyFlush
methods.description: Flushes slot to key mappings.

methods.name: slotToKeyDestroy
methods.description: Destroys slot to key mappings.

methods.name: clusterUpdateMyselfFlags
methods.description: Updates flags for this node.

methods.name: clusterUpdateMyselfIp
methods.description: Updates IP address info for this node.

methods.name: slotToChannelAdd
methods.description: Adds a channel to slot mapping.

methods.name: slotToChannelDel
methods.description: Removes a channel from slot mapping.

methods.name: clusterUpdateMyselfHostname
methods.description: Updates hostname info for this node.

methods.name: clusterUpdateMyselfAnnouncedPorts
methods.description: Updates announced ports for this node.

methods.name: freeClusterLink
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a cluster link.
